name: worker-curated-lists
description: Cloudflare Worker that scrapes curated movie/show lists (Metacritic, Rotten Tomatoes) via Firecrawl, resolves IMDb IDs via OMDb, and filters to titles available on the PopcornTime catalog.

scripts.refresh: wrangler deploy --dry-run && echo 'Use POST /admin/refresh?id=<listId> on a deployed worker'
